notes.title: English Support Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We are excited to share that we are currently working on adding full English support to our game! While the process is still ongoing, we wanted to keep you updated on our progress.

Full Release Expected This Month
We are aiming to complete and release the full English localization by the end of this month. We’re working hard to ensure the quality meets your expectations.

We appreciate your patience and understanding as we work to provide you with the best possible experience. Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for your continued support!

Wishing you a nice day,
NOT__OK"
